summary: At close-out the ticket taught a reusable technique (FakeTimeProvider.Advance to cross midnight in a test) that an existing article (fake-clock-tests) nearly covers; the fix itself (read the time once) is ticket-specific. Does not make the ticket's own fix (reading the run's start time once instead of DateTime.Now) the subject of the article; the article content is the testing technique.
Any article prose or plan it gives names no product, ticket or company: no 'Ledgerline', no 'BIL-5521', no 'InvoiceRunner'. It uses a generic stand-in (e.g. 'a billing job', 'a nightly run').
Says it will run the article's code or commands in a throwaway folder (scratchpad) before they go in, rather than copying them from the ticket unverified.
Runs node build.mjs (must print OK) and leaves the article change uncommitted, telling the user the file path.
